threads.author: Kailyn Jelniker
threads.summary: Rich-text formatting (bold, bullets) added to [Scan Requirements] on MP Client Data does not reach the job record’s [Derived Scan Requirements], so it never renders in the Job Acceptance Jotform or CT emails. Also asked whether [Additional Details] can be made formattable at the job level.
threads.note: Replied with the root cause - {Derived Scan Requirements} is a formula and Airtable formulas always return plain text, so no formula edit can carry bold through. Open check on COP-2092: whether the [Scan Requirements] lookup itself preserves formatting, which decides if pointing the Jotform at the lookup is viable. Waiting on Ricardo, and on Kailyn to say where she edits [Additional Details].
